name: Gio Quan lon Tra Vong
summary: The homepage calls this a folk festival for Huỳnh Công Giản on lunar 15 and 16 of the third month. It does not name the commune, and a program was not on that page. The place, the solar date, and the fee are check on arrival. It is not the Holy See and not Ba Den.
when: Lunar 15 and 16 of the third month. The commune and the solar date: check on arrival.
